def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("black car")
    buildings = image_patch.find("building")
    
    if not cars or not buildings:
        return []
    
    # Find the building that is closest to the center of the image
    building_center_x = sum(building.horizontal_center for building in buildings) / len(buildings)
    closest_building = min(buildings, key=lambda b: abs(b.horizontal_center - building_center_x))
    
    # Find the cars that are closest to the building
    car_distances = [(car, abs(car.horizontal_center - closest_building.horizontal_center)) for car in cars]
    car_distances.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    
    # Select the cars that are within a reasonable distance of the building
    adjacent_cars = [car for car, dist in car_distances if dist < 100]  # Adjust the threshold as needed
    
    return adjacent_cars
